samples.label: sample-01
samples.evidence: Nine red targets staggered from the near barricade back to the wall, a fully modelled soldier in dark fatigues holding a rifle standing left of centre, black locker cubes and a grey ramp with white-railed walkway on the right, and HUD state that shows the loop running: SCORE 0100, TIME 57, 30 / 89 reserve and objective counted down to 'HIT 11 TARGETS'.
samples.biggestGap: The reference's targets sit on visible steel stands and are fewer and larger; here several red rectangles float unsupported against the wall and the target count is padded, so the range reads as decals rather than physical props.

samples.label: sample-02
samples.evidence: Seven small red targets on thin two-leg steel stands spread across a flat mid-ground, a curved segmented barrier bottom-left with a cast ground shadow, canopy and ramp at right, and HUD showing SCORE 0150 / TIME 57 / 29 / 90 with the objective at 'HIT 11 TARGETS'.
samples.biggestGap: Camera sits far back with the whole range compressed into a thin band: the targets are a fraction of the reference's size and the lower half of the frame is empty tile, losing the reference's near-barricade depth layering.

samples.label: sample-03
samples.evidence: Dense mid-ground: eight red targets at four depth bands, grey stepped barricade across centre, curved wall left with a soft elliptical shadow, black lockers plus grey ramp and railed walkway right, SCAR with EOTech and camo sleeve bottom right; HUD reads SCORE 0000 / TIME 60 / 30 / 90, an untouched opening frame.
samples.biggestGap: No evidence of the loop having run — score zero, full magazine, timer at 60 — and the patrolling soldier is almost entirely hidden behind a target, unlike the reference where the figure is clearly silhouetted against the wall.

samples.label: sample-04
samples.evidence: Same rich layout as sample-03 — staggered red targets, stepped concrete barricade, curved barrier and its ground shadow, lockers, ramp and white-railed walkway — with only a sliver of the soldier's red-brown torso poking past the centre-left target; HUD SCORE 0000 / TIME 60 / 30 / 90.
samples.biggestGap: Pristine start state (zero score, 30 / 90, timer 60) gives no proof shooting, scoring or reloading work, and the enemy is occluded to a thin colour fragment.

samples.label: sample-05
samples.evidence: A clearly readable soldier in camo with a slung rifle stands at the wall left of centre, six red targets sit on visible thin stands atop the concrete barricades, and the HUD shows SCORE 0100 / TIME 58 / 29 / 90 with 'HIT 11 TARGETS' — one round fired and one target down.
samples.biggestGap: The camera is pushed low and forward so the leftmost target is sliced by the frame edge and the ramp is cropped at the right border; the reference keeps the whole yard and its far wall inside the frame.

samples.label: sample-06
samples.evidence: Seven small red targets on slender steel stands, a stepped grey barricade dead centre under the crosshair, curved barrier with cast shadow left, canopy and dark ramp right; HUD complete with SCORE 0000, green HEALTH 100, orange TIME 59, 30 / 90 and the bottom legend bar.
samples.biggestGap: The range reads as a distant diorama — targets are only ~30 px tall against the reference's near-half-screen ones — and no patrolling soldier is visible anywhere in the yard.

samples.label: sample-07
samples.evidence: Identical framing to sample-06: same seven stand-mounted targets, same centre barricade, curved barrier and ramp, same untouched HUD (SCORE 0000, TIME 59, 30 / 90, 'HIT 12 TARGETS'), rifle and camo sleeve anchored bottom-right.
samples.biggestGap: Flat, far-back composition with no enemy and no fired-shot state; the reference's foreground occlusion and large near targets are absent, leaving the bottom 40% of the frame as bare tile.

samples.label: sample-08
samples.evidence: HUD shows SCORE 0150 / TIME 56 / 30 / 89 and 'HIT 11 TARGETS', so firing, scoring and reload all registered, and a tiny dark enemy figure sits by the canopy at mid-right; scene is the same stand-mounted target layout with curved barrier and ramp.
samples.biggestGap: The weapon has drifted off the viewport — the rifle body is clipped at the right and bottom edges with the gloved hand and forearm almost entirely gone, whereas the reference shows a full arm, glove and receiver anchoring the lower right third.

comparisonVerdict.rationale: Sample-01 is the only frame that combines a fully readable armed soldier, the densest layered target field with lockers, ramp and railed walkway at reference scale, and HUD state (SCORE 0100, 30 / 89, 11 targets left) proving the shoot-score-reload loop ran.
